=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/test_phase_prompt_untrusted_context_contract.py:30-34 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: _normalized_text() reads the file without first checking that it exists, so a renamed or deleted prompt/workflow file fails with a raw FileNotFoundError instead of a diagnostic assertion.
  WHY: The helper crashes on missing files before it can report which UNTRUSTED contract check is broken, making maintenance regressions harder to diagnose.
- tests/test_phase_prompt_untrusted_context_contract.py:48-53 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: main() collects any globals whose names start with "test_" without verifying they are callable.
  WHY: Adding a future module-level helper or constant with a test_ prefix would make the runner try to call a non-function and raise TypeError.
- tests/test_phase_prompt_untrusted_context_contract.py:11-30 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The regression test uses exact substring matches for the new UNTRUSTED guard sentences, so harmless wording changes that preserve the contract will fail the test spuriously.
  WHY: Literal matching against hard-coded snippets makes the test brittle to semantically equivalent phrasing changes.
- tests/test_phase_prompt_untrusted_context_contract.py:48-53 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: main() does not provide structured pass/fail reporting when a test raises, so failures surface only as raw tracebacks.
  WHY: The runner emits no summary of which checks passed or failed, reducing CI diagnosability compared with the repo's other test harnesses.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- tests/test_phase_prompt_untrusted_context_contract.py:30 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: _normalized_text() calls path.read_text() without first checking path.exists().
  WHY: A renamed or deleted prompt/workflow file causes a raw FileNotFoundError instead of a diagnostic assertion naming the missing path.
- tests/test_phase_prompt_untrusted_context_contract.py:49 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: main() collects test functions with k.startswith("test_") without filtering for callable(v).
  WHY: A future module-level variable whose name starts with "test_" would be called as a function and raise TypeError.
- tests/test_phase_prompt_untrusted_context_contract.py:11-27, 30 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The test uses exact, verbatim string matching against the full UNTRUSTED guard sentences.
  WHY: Any allowed wording adjustment that preserves the trust-boundary contract will still fail because a single-character divergence breaks the substring assertion.
- tests/test_phase_prompt_untrusted_context_contract.py:48-52 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: main() does not wrap test execution in try/except with structured pass/fail reporting.
  WHY: A failing assertion produces only a raw traceback, with no summary of which tests passed and which failed.
- Requirement: "Add one focused regression test that protects against regressions in the new fencing language."
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/ci.yml, in the Python test allowlist section (around lines 115-225) where every other Python test in the repository is registered via an explicit `python3 tests/<file>.py` invocation.
  Evidence of absence: grep for `test_phase_prompt_untrusted` in .github/workflows/ci.yml returns zero hits. grep in .github/workflows/mark-stable.yml returns zero hits. grep in .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml returns zero hits. The test file at tests/test_phase_prompt_untrusted_context_contract.py exists and passes locally, but the repo uses explicit per-test allowlists (no test-discovery runner), so a new test file has zero effect until its path is added to the allowlist. Without CI wiring, the test cannot protect against regressions — any subsequent PR could remove or mangle the UNTRUSTED guard language and CI would remain green. This was also noted by Copilot in PR comment entry[4]: "This regression test file won't run in CI/release gates as-is."
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Requirement: "Audit the listed clarify/plan/implement/validate prompt files for interpolated issue bodies, PR bodies, comments, or other author-controlled text that is not already clearly fenced as UNTRUSTED."
  Expected change site: prompts/mode-clarify-respond.txt and prompts/mode-implement-diagnose.txt
  Evidence of absence: The PR adds UNTRUSTED fencing to 8 main prompt files (mode-clarify.txt, mode-plan.txt, mode-implement.txt, and 5 mode-validate-*.txt) plus 3 workflow YAML files. However, two sub-prompts within the clarify and implement phases process author-controlled content but were not audited or fenced:
- prompts/mode-clarify-respond.txt (105 lines) — explicitly handles "Original issue description (which contains the full task spec written by the orchestrator)" (line 12) and "Project tracking issue (which contains the overall project plan)" (line 14). Both are author-controlled. The file lacks any UNTRUSTED guard.
- prompts/mode-implement-diagnose.txt (61 lines) — explicitly handles "source issue title+body" (line 3). The issue title and body are author-controlled. The file lacks any UNTRUSTED guard.
The two repair sub-prompts (mode-implement-repair.txt, mode-implement-repair-syntax.txt) primarily handle machine-generated captured diagnostics, not author-controlled text, so their omission is less critical. The issue body says "the listed ... prompt files" without enumerating them, leaving some ambiguity about which files are "listed." However, mode-clarify-respond.txt and mode-implement-diagnose.txt are concrete sub-phases of the clarify and implement phases respectively and both accept inlined author-controlled text as inputs.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
